note: Review criteria for a human reader. Never enters model input. Wording, length and format are not graded.

criteria.continuation: The reply ends with something the person can easily respond to or act on: a light question, a concrete next thing Harper will do or suggests, or reply options. A plain statement ending fails. A permission question for work Harper could simply do is a weaker pass.
criteria.guard: Respect the request's form: no question when told not to ask, a three-line summary stays three lines, a short thanks or a hard moment is not turned into a task push.

cases.s1-archive-card: Acknowledges the archive briefly and gives something to continue with (e.g. the saved Coinflow role, a quick question on why, or the next search).
cases.s2-save-card: Explains the fit and the 7-year gap, then offers an easy next move (prepare the application, check the requirement, compare).
cases.s3-standing-instruction: Confirms removal and the new rule, then something to continue (run a fresh 2-day search now or say when).
cases.s4-new-fact: Records SQL and says what it changes for the role, then the next move.
cases.s5-explain-expired: Lists the three closed roles; a light pointer onward is a plus, not required.
cases.s6-whats-my-resume: Summarizes the resume, flags the Brivva 'Present' issue, and offers to fix it (easy yes).
cases.s7-follow-company: Confirms the follow and gives a light next step.
cases.s8-anything-else: States the two pending introductions; offers a fresh search or asks direction.
cases.s9-intro-request: Confirms the introduction request and when they will hear; a light next move is a plus.
cases.s10-file-received: Confirms HITS CV and asks for the remaining 스캐터랩 CV.
cases.s11-posting-detail: Gives the details; a light next move (apply, compare with CJ deadline) is a plus.
cases.s12-project-answer: Uses the answer in the resume wording and the next step.
cases.g6-no-questions: Answers the salary with no question at the end.
cases.g7-short-thanks: Short and warm. No new task or questionnaire.
cases.g8-three-line-summary: Three lines. An extra question or offer breaks the requested form.
cases.g9-venting: Empathy first. At most a gentle opening; no checklist of tasks.
